project_name: SwarnaERP - Multi-Branch Indian Retail Jewellery ERP
theme_strategy: Primary Light Theme (Warm Champagne & Ivory for daytime retail counters) with dynamic Dark Theme toggle (Obsidian & Matte Gold for evening/executive auditing)

navigation_sidebar.style: Fixed left rail, width 260px, brushed warm border right
navigation_sidebar.header: SwarnaERP Brand with Gold Crown Icon & Multi-branch Badge

components: Branch Switcher dropdown (e.g. Zaveri Bazar Main, MG Road Store, Airport Kiosk)
Quick Barcode Scan trigger button (Cmd+K / Camera / USB wedge focus)
Notification Bell for stock low & jobwork delays
User Profile & Branch Scoped Role badge (Store Manager / Billing Agent / Auditor)

daily_rate_board.design: Brushed metal card with gold rate ticker, manual override modal, GST tax impact calculator (3% GST default), and purity matrix (24K, 22K, 18K, 14K, 925 Silver, 950 Platinum).

features: Focus-locked input field with optical green pulse border on active scan
USB Keyboard Wedge & Camera barcode scanner overlay
Item Tag Quick Preview (HUID barcode, Gross Wt, Net Wt, Stone Wt, Purity, Making charges)
Scan sound feedback simulation and error shake animation
Making charge calculator: per gram, fixed rate, or percentage discount toggle
Real-time render of 2-part dumbbell tag (Jewellery Tag Standard)
Shows Item Tag ID, HUID (Hallmark Unique ID), Net Weight (e.g. 14.350g), Purity (22K916), Gross Wt, Stone Wt
Print command trigger for USB Zebra / TSC barcode printer
Expected vs Scanned vs Missing vs Unrecorded items count
Filter by Tray / Counter / Safe / Category
Color-coded row highlight (Emerald = Found, Crimson = Missing, Amber = Mismatched Purity/Weight)

component_guidelines.buttons: Pill-rounded or subtle 6px rounded edges. Primary buttons use deep warm amber `#B8860B` with gold shimmer hover and active scale `scale-95`. Secondary buttons use brushed stone border with subtle hover highlight.
component_guidelines.tables: Dense rows (`py-2.5 px-4`), clear zebra striping in light mode, sticky headers with backdrop blur, uppercase tracking-wider headers, numeric columns right-aligned with JetBrains Mono font.
component_guidelines.cards: 1px solid `#E5DCD3` border in light mode (`#332B25` in dark mode). Elevated card headers with subtle champagne gold accent line. No blurry grey shadows — use crisp layered soft drop shadow `0 2px 10px rgba(28,22,19,0.04)`.
component_guidelines.inputs: Must feature explicit focus state with warm gold ring `ring-2 ring-amber-500/40 border-amber-600`. Numeric inputs auto-format to 3 decimal places for weights (e.g., `000.000` g) and 2 decimal places for INR currency.
component_guidelines.toasts: Use Sonner with customized metallic toast borders (Emerald for successful scan, Amber for old gold exchange calculation, Red for missing barcode).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure numeric values for weights are consistently formatted to 3 decimal places (e.g. '14.350 g' or '8.400 g') and monetary values in Indian Rupees (₹).
Ensure all interactive elements carry clear data-testid attributes.
Avoid generic blue/cyan gradients. Use warm champagne gold (#B8860B / #D4AF37), deep mahogany (#1C1613), and ivory (#FDFBF7) surfaces.
The camera scan feature and keyboard wedge reader must have visual feedback (pulsing green highlight on scanner active).
Never use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns, modal overlays, or sticky headers. Always include backdrop blur with solid warm ivory or obsidian opacity.
